motion_system: Still by default. On deliberate interaction, point spacing loosens only beside the single raster aperture, then settles; no autonomous pulsing or field-wide movement.
color_drift: None across the field; preserve the distinct indigo, violet, mint, and gold color roles.
glow_behavior: Localized cyan-white bloom at a few contour bends; a brief contraction beside the aperture during interaction, without rings or sweeping flares.
